registrySummary: TKGM's official regional page lists UŞAK KADASTRO MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ/UŞAK and UŞAK TAPU MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ/UŞAK. The current public Parsel Sorgu viewer is first-party and its configuration exposes the MEGSİS API.

sourceCandidate.kind: Public TKGM Parsel Sorgu / MEGSİS coordinate parcel API

queryAndRequestReview: Separate English and Turkish first-party discovery was performed. The official viewer HTML and JavaScript configuration were retrieved, then the province list and exact WUP-point parcel endpoint were requested anonymously with ordinary GET and viewer-origin headers. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification exception was used.
